explanation: Gather every original node from every input list, sort the references by value, and relink them as one sorted terminated chain. Original nodes and values are reused rather than copied.
timeComplexity: O(k + N log(N+1)) time for k lists and N total nodes.
attribution: Original repository-authored Blind75 C++ algorithm, promoted from the validated correct fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
